scope: Replace the full-width toolbar shadow with a short, soft scroll fade bounded by the conversation pane and centered on its content.

keep: Toolbar layout, extension control, conversation scrolling, and composer treatment
extend: Show the content-only fade after scrolling

architecture.reason: Reuses the current transcript scroll listener and theme surface; no new service.

egress.description: No network or external action changes.

tests.scope: Assert the new fade is conversation-owned, non-interactive, and hidden before scrolling; assert the toolbar has no pseudo-element shadow.

tests.command: GitHub Actions: Isolated Supabase authenticated browser verification
tests.scope: Check fade visibility and transcript-only bounds at desktop and mobile widths.

rollout: Verify the scoped preview, run the release gates, and stage the same source before promotion.
rollback: Re-promote the previous verified frontend build; no database changes.

blockers: Run the signed-in browser and release checks on the candidate.
